<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="22" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">8:23</text>
    <rect x="313" y="13" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="319" y="10" width="4" height="11" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="325" y="7" width="4" height="14" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="331" y="4" width="4" height="17" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="14" r="4.2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="14" x2="347" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="13" x2="346" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="12.8" r="3.2" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="366" cy="16" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="339" y="5" width="27" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="366" y="8.2" width="2" height="6.6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="341" y="7" width="19" height="9" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="20" y="54" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">Skip</text>

  <!-- Headline -->
  <text x="20" y="114" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#363A50">
    <tspan x="20" dy="0">Search for</tspan>
    <tspan x="20" dy="27">somewhere new</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="20" y="170" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#383A4D">
    <tspan x="20" dy="0">Tell us what you want to explore and we’ll</tspan>
    <tspan x="20" dy="20">help you find flights, stays, and ideas.</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Illustration card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="56" y="214" width="278" height="262" rx="28" fill="#F3F2F0"/>
    <rect x="68" y="228" width="254" height="232" rx="22" fill="#F3F2F0"/>
    <rect x="80" y="246" width="230" height="174" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="92" y="259" width="138" height="16" rx="8" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    <rect x="92" y="285" width="88" height="10" rx="5" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    <rect x="92" y="302" width="62" height="10" rx="5" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    <rect x="92" y="317" width="102" height="10" rx="5" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    <rect x="92" y="347" width="84" height="10" rx="5" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    <rect x="92" y="362" width="118" height="10" rx="5" fill="#EFECE9"/>
    <rect x="92" y="377" width="72" height="10" rx="5" fill="#EFECE9"/>

    <!-- search field in illustration -->
    <rect x="108" y="414" width="154" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DCDCDA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="126" cy="431" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#7B7D85" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="130.5" y1="435.5" x2="135.5" y2="440.5" stroke="#7B7D85" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="142" y="435" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">Where to?</text>

    <!-- blue search bubble -->
    <ellipse cx="278" cy="280" rx="36" ry="36" fill="#B6C2EE"/>
    <ellipse cx="278" cy="280" rx="30" ry="30" fill="#9FAEE9"/>
    <circle cx="270" cy="273" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="274" y="276" width="14" height="4" rx="2" transform="rotate(32 274 276)" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="258" y="292" width="32" height="10" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="176" cy="300" r="22" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <rect x="154" y="323" width="112" height="38" rx="19" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <rect x="150" y="334" width="120" height="14" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="293" cy="356" r="18" fill="#3950AB"/>
    <rect x="281" y="374" width="38" height="10" rx="5" fill="#3950AB"/>

    <!-- airplane / map pin details -->
    <polygon points="250,325 262,330 250,335 254,330" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="262" y1="330" x2="276" y2="322" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="262" y1="330" x2="276" y2="338" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="305" cy="320" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="305,308 307,315 314,315 308,319 310,326 305,321 300,326 302,319 296,315 303,315" fill="#161C35"/>
    <text x="115" y="402" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#3D4257">What are you looking for?</text>
    <text x="129" y="434" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Family beach vacation</text>
    <text x="106" y="370" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">$238</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Pager dots -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="178" cy="520" r="5" fill="#363A50"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="520" r="5" fill="#7F7F7F"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="520" r="5" fill="#7F7F7F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Next button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="546" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D4D4D2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="576" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4F67C9">Next</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Supporting cards -->
  <text x="20" y="636" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">Popular ways to search</text>
  <text x="324" y="636" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">See all</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="650" width="350" height="78" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="21.5" y="651.5" width="350" height="78" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="32" y="662" width="54" height="54" rx="12" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="682" r="7" fill="#B6C2EE"/>
    <polygon points="41,704 50,692 58,699 63,694 76,704" fill="#9FAEE9"/>
    <text x="100" y="676" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">City break</text>
    <text x="100" y="694" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Weekend stays in New York, Chicago, and Seattle</text>
    <text x="100" y="712" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">From $129 per night</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="740" width="350" height="78" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="21.5" y="741.5" width="350" height="78" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="32" y="752" width="54" height="54" rx="12" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="768" r="6" fill="#F5E070"/>
    <rect x="43" y="776" width="32" height="12" rx="6" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <polygon points="40,804 52,789 60,796 72,780 77,784 77,804" fill="#B6C2EE"/>
    <text x="100" y="766" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#161C35">Beach getaway</text>
    <text x="100" y="784" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Search warm-weather escapes and family resorts</text>
    <text x="100" y="802" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">Rated 4.8 by travelers</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="776" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="776" x2="390" y2="776" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g transform="translate(28,788)">
      <polygon points="12,4 2,12 22,12" fill="#4F67C9"/>
      <rect x="6" y="12" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#4F67C9"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4F67C9">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Search -->
    <g transform="translate(108,788)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="17" x2="22" y2="22" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Search</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Trips -->
    <g transform="translate(186,788)">
      <rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="1" x2="8" y2="9" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="16" y1="1" x2="16" y2="9" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Trips</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Saved -->
    <g transform="translate(262,788)">
      <polygon points="12,4 16,8 21,9 17,13 18,18 12,15 6,18 7,13 3,9 8,8" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Account -->
    <g transform="translate(332,788)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="5" y="15" width="14" height="9" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Account</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
